verdict.rationale: monday.com documents a public GraphQL/apps API and developer platform with granular scopes, webhooks/subscriptions, and programmatic control ('run and manage every monday agent programmatically from your own code'), which directly supports AI-native driving of the product; community evidence cited is about general product usability, not the API, so it doesn't dispute this axis. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the API's robustness or reference implementation (e.g., a working llms.txt or third-party integration report), since the llms.txt probe returned 404.
